column12: Judgement on the tier: half of a mid-teens royalty, 0.5 x 15% = 7.5% of sales, the lowest tier because early sales sit in it; the top tier (0.5 x 25%) gives 0.5447. The side effect: the company revenue roll-up multiplies revenue by the same share, so it shows 32.7% of Veppanu's sales where Pfizer books 7.5%.
